hypothesis: A discard-free opaque level pipeline restores hidden-surface removal on Apple GPUs.
notes: Conservative projected cutaway bounds preserve draw order. Final confirmation was 5.849 ms; optional effects disabled.

hypothesis: Center-ray shortcuts and cone-ray culling reduce shadow work.
notes: Rejected for correctness: neighboring filter rays may hit occluders even when the center ray is clear. Retained inherited exact per-tap early-outs without attributing an independent speedup.

hypothesis: Cache static occluder packing per light.
notes: LightCuller.cache already does this. Game.build allocation reuse was deferred because of concurrent edits.

hypothesis: Exact light-matrix reuse can skip the static shadow pass.
notes: All seven runs had zero reusable matrices; depth translation changes every frame. No texture cache added.

hypothesis: Separate opaque and cutaway pipelines improve early depth rejection.
notes: GPU delta is within combined MAD; CPU increased from 0.659 to 0.756 ms. Experimental changes reverted.

hypothesis: Pack public entities once per broadcast instead of per recipient.
notes: Identical complete serialized-output digest. Ack, mode and inventory remain recipient-specific.

hypothesis: Prepare car fields and standings once per broadcast.
notes: Identical complete serialized-output digest. Visibility, gadgets, props and repairs remain recipient-specific.

hypothesis: An AABB precheck avoids costly collision tests.
notes: Slower with identical serialized output; reverted.

hypothesis: Reusing bot intent objects reduces per-tick allocation.
notes: Reverted control matched the candidate within MAD. Apparent improvement was not attributable to the change.
